flags.why: This traditional noun is mainly Southern usage, especially in the Mekong Delta, as recorded in [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/n%C3%AD).
The sworn-sibling meaning belongs to the Southern tradition of [kết ní](https://maistelevisao.pt/ket-ni-la-gi-ma-nguoi-mien-tay-coi-nhau-nhu-ruot-thit-185260807092121421.htm).
The example explains what heroin is instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Cảnh sát tìm thấy bạch phiến trong túi của hắn. = The police found heroin in his bag.

flags.why: The drawer meaning is Central and Southern usage, documented in the [Huế dialect dictionary](https://khungcuahep.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/T%E1%BB%AB-%C4%90i%E1%BB%83n-Ph%C6%B0%C6%A1ng-Ng%E1%BB%AF-Hu%E1%BA%BF-Tr%E1%BA%A7n-Ng%E1%BB%8Dc-B%E1%BA%A3o.pdf).
